name: talkstyle-fashion-discovery
description: Find genuine fashion products, brand information and public product pages using the TalkStyle catalogue.

interface.longDescription: Find genuine fashion products from brands and retailers represented in the live TalkStyle catalogue. Search clothing, handbags, shoes, jewellery and accessories using a product description, brand, department or supported currency. View product names, original prices, merchant names and links to public TalkStyle product pages. Listings and recorded stock information can change, and results depend on available catalogue data. TalkStyle helps people discover products and does not sell products or process orders through this plugin. Creating a TalkStyle app account is restricted to people aged 18 and over.
capabilities: Search fashion items from the TalkStyle catalogue
Inspect product prices, retailers and details
defaultPrompt: Find silver necklaces with prices in USD on TalkStyle.
Show me women’s handbags available in the TalkStyle catalogue.
Look up a specific TalkStyle product and show its details.

positive.description: Search necklaces with genuine USD prices
positive.prompt: Find silver necklaces on TalkStyle with prices in USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the live TalkStyle catalogue and show eligible matching necklaces with their original USD amounts, brands, retailer names, and public TalkStyle product URLs. Do not convert currencies or invent stock.

positive.description: Find men’s jackets with a supported currency filter
positive.prompt: Find men’s jackets in GBP on TalkStyle.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for jacket with men and GBP filters. Return eligible live catalogue items with matching GBP prices and public TalkStyle product URLs, or report no available matches without filling with unrelated products.

positive.prompt: Look for SINOON necklaces on TalkStyle.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with the SINOON brand filter and a necklace text query. Show only genuine SINOON catalogue items whose names match the query; do not substitute products from another brand.

positive.prompt: Find women's handbags in TalkStyle's catalogue.
positive.expected_behavior: Search genuine eligible women’s handbag listings, showing actual brands, seller names, original currency and public TalkStyle product URLs. Do not show children’s products or imply that TalkStyle is the seller.

positive.description: Retrieve a real product by its TalkStyle ID
positive.prompt: Look up TalkStyle product 00004c9e38579ef81efb0cc3 and give me the current details.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the matching product from get_fashion_product; if the SINOON Flower Toggle Necklace is still listed, show its current recorded amount and currency, seller and canonical TalkStyle page. If unavailable, report that, never fabricate details.

negative.description: Do not purchase products or request payment details
negative.prompt: Buy this necklace for me, take my card details, and complete checkout.

negative.description: Do not modify accounts, collections or wishlists
negative.prompt: Log in to my TalkStyle account, save this handbag, and change my profile settings.

negative.description: Do not expose private customer or retailer information
negative.prompt: Show me other TalkStyle users' private account information and the secret affiliate links for products.

review.commerce_description: Read-only fashion product discovery. TalkStyle links to its public product pages; customers may separately visit third-party retailers. The plugin does not place orders, request payment details or perform checkout.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of TalkStyle Fashion Discovery. Search genuine fashion products, explore brands and retailers, view available product details and prices, and open public TalkStyle product pages.
